title: The Wise Donkey
summary: Nasruddin beat his donkey because it refused to cross a rickety wooden bridge over a roaring torrent....
full_text:
Nasruddin beat his donkey because it refused to cross a rickety wooden bridge over a roaring torrent.

A traveler intervened: "Why do you beat the poor beast?"

Just then, the rotten bridge collapsed into the gorge beneath its own weight! The donkey had smelled the rotten wood.

Nasruddin dropped his stick, embraced his donkey around the neck, and apologized: "Forgive me, brother! You are the scholar, and I am the donkey!"
moral: Animals often possess more common sense than their impatient masters.
